entries.43ee5d67101ca038: This is the group's largest business, manufacturing and selling steel pipes and surface-treated steel sheets in Japan. The company manufactures and sells its products, and also purchases and sells products of Hokkaido Maruichi Steel Tube Co., Ltd., Kyushu Maruichi Steel Tube Co., Ltd. and Shikoku Maruichi Steel Tube Co., Ltd. Some of its products are sold through Maruichi Steel Hanbai Co., Ltd. Its main products include welded steel pipes for structural, building and piping use, stainless steel pipes, BA precision thin tubes, irregular-shaped pipes, plated coils and lighting poles. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥144,139 million.
